environment.description: Same Node.js 16 Apollo Server 3.x on ECS Fargate in us-east-1 within private subnet. Traffic routed through VPC endpoint for S3 (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with endpoint policy restricting s3:PutObject to condition aws:sourceVpce matching the endpoint ID AND requiring s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption header. The VPC endpoint policy also includes a Deny statement for any S3 action when aws:PrincipalTag/service-tier does not equal 'validated-request'. The ECS task role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ExportBoundary) that denies s3:PutObject unless the request passes through a Lambda@Edge validation layer that performs schema-level null checking on resolver inputs before forwarding. Additionally, the ALB has a target group with deregistration_delay=300s and health_check_interval=5s with unhealthy_threshold=2, combined with ECS service minimum_healthy_percent=100 and desired_count=3 with circuit breaker enabled (rollback on deployment failure). The service mesh (App Mesh) envoy sidecar intercepts outbound S3 calls and applies a retry policy with outlier detection ejecting the task after 2 consecutive 5xx errors within 10s.
